Trust.Title: Trust this signaling server?
Trust.Intro: {0} uses a certificate that no public authority issued, as self-hosted servers usually do. Trust it only if this fingerprint matches the server's CA certificate (on the server: openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in <CA certificate>).
Trust.Note: Once trusted, it is kept on this computer (signal-ca.pem) for both connecting and remote control. Turn remote control off and on again for it to take effect there.
Trust.SavedHost: The server is now trusted: turn remote control off and on again to use it.
Trust.Failed: Could not check the server's certificate: {0}
